title: Assassins in the department store.
content: So, I’ve been having dreams in mall world for years. Never had a name for it. But recently, I saw some videos on it, and immediately recognized it. I see the place as somewhere that traps our spiritual energy into a consumer based plane where we have no ability to learn or grow spiritually. It’s a place that dulls the soul and keeps us from reaching anything more than a superficial version of our spiritual potential. And I believe this place to be unnaturally intentional for these purposes. So, after hearing of mall world and now having a name for it, I found myself there two nights ago. I became fully aware that I was there and saw it for what it was. Short lived, but fully lucid. I was determined to destroy it, like start a type of revolution so that we could break the illusion of the place. Nothing much came of it because I woke up quickly after. But last night I found myself back at mall world. This time I was completely in the trance of the dream and unaware of where I was. The mall was sparsely populated & I was just roaming. I found myself in a department store and then out of nowhere a chord was tightened around my neck from some sort of assassin behind me. It had no face or distinguishing characteristics other than giving off the feeling that it wanted to destroy me. I fought the thing off. And then moments later another one came after me and basically the scenario repeated. After a lengthy battle I fought off both assassins. Moments later, a “Representative” visited me holding either a tablet or a clipboard. She was a large woman dressed in like business professional clothing. She gave off like an HR or PR rep vibes. She was fascinated at the fact that I was still alive. I told her about what happened and she said that it’s actually a common occurrence for anyone who tries to go after the generator. Remind you, in this dream I was never aware or even remotely lucid. When I woke up, I decided that the mission is clear. I need to go back to mall world, lucidly this time, and take out the generator. Not sure what the affects of that will end up being or if it’s even possible, but I feel strongly convicted that it’s something I need to do. Anyone have any advice for me, or have had any experiences like this before?
